answer_2.quote: We propose an automated evaluation protocol using GPT-4V. Specifically, we save screenshots throughout the online navigation process and then use GPT-4V to evaluate these trajectories together with the final results automatically.

answer_3.quote: We employ GPT-4V, Claude-3-Opus, and GPT-4o as backbones for WebVoyager and run all tasks, followed by automatic evaluation using these three models.

answer_4.quote: We employ human evaluation as our main evaluation metric since most of the questions in our benchmark have open-ended answers. In particular, we provide the human evaluators with the complete trajectories of the agent's interaction with the web ... and ask them to provide a binary judgment of whether the agent successfully completed the task.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are given full interaction trajectories (screenshots and actions) and asked to judge whether the task was successfully completed.
